claim_scope: Two-page calibration subset only; this oracle supports no accuracy claim for remaining candidate material.

matching_rules.assignment: Use maximum one-to-one matching. One candidate atom can recover at most one oracle atom, and one oracle atom can be recovered at most once.

quote_match.required_source_identity: The candidate source must resolve to the same source_id or to a source-registry record with the same captured-source digest.
quote_match.anchor_role: Anchor values are reported for diagnosis but do not replace content equality or establish continuity.
quote_match.partial_or_superset_span: No match. Report the candidate as a false positive and the unrecovered oracle atom as a false negative unless a separately recorded evaluator disposition establishes equivalence before scores are computed.

claim_match.support_requirement: Every supporting quote reference must map to the corresponding matched oracle quote atom; unsupported semantic equality is not a match.
claim_match.ordering: Array order is significant where it changes meaning. Otherwise compare arrays as duplicate-free sets after the evaluator records the normalization used.
claim_match.numeric_values: Compare the JSON numeric value and unit together. Unit conversion is not automatic and requires a recorded evaluator disposition before scoring.
claim_match.qualitative_values: Exact stored value equality is the deterministic default. A semantic-equivalence override must be recorded by the independent reviewer before aggregate scores are computed.

matching_rules.false_positive: A candidate quote or claim in either matched calibration page that is not assigned to an oracle atom.
matching_rules.false_negative: An expected oracle quote or claim not assigned to a candidate atom.
matching_rules.precision: true positives divided by true positives plus false positives; report quote and claim precision separately.
matching_rules.recall: true positives divided by true positives plus false negatives; report quote and claim recall separately.
matching_rules.zero_denominator: Report not-applicable rather than substituting a perfect score.
required_diagnostics: matched oracle and candidate atom identifiers
all evaluator equivalence dispositions and their reasons
